cases.study_information: Rank the six target PD-1–VEGF bispecific antibodies from highest to lowest terminal serum half-life in the male cynomolgus IV study. AK112 is a visible same-study reference. Use matched binding, reporter and DSC measurements; missing measurements remain blank. Constructs ending .1L are distinct from .1La YTE constructs. The study used five males per group, body weights 2.5–3.9 kg, and serum follow-up through day 28. An IV dose is not specified in the accessible methods; do not infer one.
